name: Seeking Refuge
label: Quest
description: Seeking Refuge: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Light bless you for finding me. I was on my way from Bandarion Keep to deliver a message to Shari Stilwell in Brill when these monsters captured me. They wield the Light with a hatred in their hearts that makes what's left of my blood seethe. It goes against all I meditate for... All I strive to protect!
I know some still take issue with my kind, but I assure you our intentions are pure. If you would aid me in escaping this place, I would be forever grateful.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Blessings upon you for aiding Dawnstone. Our order is still taking root here and it would be devastating to lose one so promising before his time.

Please accept this as a token of our thanks. Should you ever take an interest in our ways, our monastery Bandarion Keep lies on the bluffs northwest of the Solliden Farmstead. We welcome all who seek guidance in the Light.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
